method: Built-in imagegen edit of supplied bare cave; ImageMagick used only for required JPEG conversion/resizing.

visual_review.reviewer: gathering Pepe 01, visual inspection of generated PNG
visual_review.pepe: Recognizable wide mouth and large heavy-lidded eyes in charcoal/ochre.
visual_review.hands: Two visible hands; each reviewed as four fingers and one thumb, five digits. No handprints.
visual_review.background: Square size retained; warm rock, framing, large cracks and torchlight retained visually. No ancestral gathering marks existed. Generative editing does not certify pixel-identical unpainted stone.
visual_review.pigments: Red/yellow ochre, charcoal black and chalk white; worn uneven strokes and exposed rock.
visual_review.prohibited_content: No visible letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, real people, political or hateful symbols.
visual_review.composition: Four winding trails join a basket of four stones held by Pepe.

limitations: Visual judgment is a single inspection, not independent approval.
A generated edit may alter fine stone texture despite preserving visible cave structure.
